content: Nobi okkole nizor fara bade beggulla ijjot fa
Hiba henttu giyegoi edde nizor farat aišše, ar sahabi okkol o hibar fũwati aššil.

Dórmor din zehon aišše, hibaye sinagogot šikka diya šuru goijje. Bout kiye zara hibar hota fuinne, hitara tajjuf oiye. Ar hodde, "Ei manušwaye in honttu faiye? Ei giyan in hibare diyede hiba honnuwa? Abar hibaye keramoti ham o gorer?

Iba ki gas mistiri no neki? Iba ki Moriyamor fuwa no neki? Yakub, Yusuf, Ehudah edde Simonor bái no neki? Hitar boinain okkol ki eṛe ãrar fũwati no take?" Ar endilla gori Isare loi mainšor dilot šondo aišše.
Hetunot Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Ekzon nobiye šude nizor farat, nizor egena edde nizor gór bade ar hár zagat ijjot fa."

content: Hiballa heṛe hono ḍõr keramoti ham gora šombob no o, šude hoekzon ošuikka manušor uwore hibaye hat raikke edde hitarare aram goijje.
Hitarattu biššaš naide dekiyore hibaye ammuwak oiye. Asab okkolore tobolig goitto defeṛar (Moti 10:1,9–15; Luk 9:1–6) Tarfore Isaye sairo mikkar fara fara zai manuš okkolore šikka diya šuru goijje.
Hibaye he barozon asabore hibar hãse ḍaikke edde duizon duizon gori faṭai diye, hibaye hitarare napak ruhor uwore kemota diye.
In oilde hokum okkol:

content.text: "Baisar fõtolla šude ugguwa laṛi bade, ruṭi, gaṭṭi, zalit rufar foiša, hono kissu no loiyo.
Ṭengor šendal loiba, kintu ugguwa bazuttuwaro beši no.
Tũwara zẽtte ekkan górot goliba, he fara sari no zogoi foijjonto he górot taikko.
Ar hono zagat zodi hitara tũwarare no gose edde tũwarar hota no fune, toile he zagattu zaibar šomot ṭengor tolar dúil udda zari felaiyo zene hiyan hitarar berudde goba o."

content: Toi hitara giye edde manuš okkolor hãse hitara gunattu mon firaibar babute tobolig goijje.
Hitara bout napak ruh dafaiye edde bout ošuikka manuš okkolor matat tel diye, hitarare aram goijje.
Herud edde torikotor gusoldoya Yahya

Isar bala nam ehon zana zani oigiyegoi boli badša Herude hibar babute fuinne. Kiye kiye hodde, "Torikotor gusoldoya Yahya mora okkolor butottu uwafes zinda uiṭṭe, hetolla hibar butore keramoti šoktiye ham goredde."
Ar kiye hodde, "Hiba Eliyas" Ar kiye hodde, "Bout agor nobi okkolor ḍoil hiba o ekzon nobi."
Kintu Herude zẽtte fuinne, hite hodde, "Hiba he Yahya, zar ãi holla loilam, hiba morattu zinda uṛi giyegoide!"

Kiyollahoile ei Herud, zibaye nize Yahyare dori anibolla manuš defeṛail edde hibare bandiyore ziyolot felai rakkil. Hite iyan goijjilde oilde Herudiya, ziba aššil Herudor bái Filipor biyata bou, zibare abar Herude biya goijjil.
Hiyanor zoriya Yahyaye hitare hoil, "Tor bái bouwore tui biya gora hiyan tolla ain mozin no o."
Hetolla Herudiyattu Yahyar uwore beši rag taigilgoi edde hibare marifelaito sail, kintu hibaye he mozin gori no fajjil.

Kiyollahoile Herude Yahya ekzon forhesgar edde Paki manušde hiyanolla boli hibare ijjot goitto edde hibare rokka goitto. Herude zẽtte Yahyar hotabatra funito, hẽtte hitar dilot beši goṭboṭ oi zaitoi, tarfore o kintu hite hibar hota funito.
Šeše ek šuzug faiye. Herude hitar zormo dinor din hitar usol tokkar ofisar okkol, meliṭari komanḍar okkol edde Galilor zimmadar manuš okkol, itarare ugguwa hána diye.
Herudiyar zi aiyore naisse. Herud edde hitar meheman okkolore hibaye eto kuši goijje. Hetunot badšaye hodde, "Tui zin sos ãi tore hin diyum?"
Ar hite ziyore hosom haiyore wada goijje "Tui zin sos, ãi tore diyum, enki ãr raijjo oddok udda."
Ziye zaiyore hibar mare hodde, "Ãi ki saiyum?" Hibaye zuwabe hodde, "Torikotor gusoldoya Yahyar matawa."
Zerfuwaye hehon zaiyore badšare hodde, "Ekkan talot gori ãi torikotor gusoldoya Yahyar matawa ehon sai."
Ei hota funi badša beši ferešan oiye, kintu meheman okkolor muntu hosom háiye boli ziyor hotare no fela.
Toi badšaye hehon ekzon zollatore Yahyar matawa anibolla hokum loi defeṛaiye. Toi hite ziyolhanat zaiyore Yahyar mata haṛi loiyore,
ekkan talot gori loi aišše edde hiba zerfuwaware diye, bade hibaye mataware hibar mare diye.
Ei hóbor hibar šagirit okkole funiyore hitar aišše edde hibar lašwa loizai ek hoborot raikkegoi.
Isaye fãs hazar manušore hána diye
Asab okkol abar Isar hãse ekotro oiye edde hitara ki ki goijje hin edde manuš okkolore zin zin šikka diye hin beggunor babute hibare zanaiye.
Toi, hibaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Ãr fũwati ekkan nirzon zagat aiyo zeṛe ãra alok oi faijjum edde ekka aram gorogai"

content: Kiyollahoile heṛe beša beši manuš okkol aza goijjil boli hitara hána háibar ṭaim udda no fail.
Hitara not gori ekkan nirzon zagat giye.
Kintu bout kiye hitara zadde dekiyore hitarare sini faijje, ar hár fara okkolottu manuš dũri age zai heṛe hazir oiyegoi.

Isaye nottu zehon laimme ek ḍõr mainšor dol dekilo. Hibattu hitarar uwore beši maya oiye, kiyollahoile hitara soroya sara soolor ḍoil oiye. Toi hibaye hitarare bout kissur babute šikka diya šuru goijje.
Zehon din šeš oi aiššil, hetunot sahabi okkole Isar hãse aiyore hodde, "Zagagan nirzon zaga, ar din o giyegoi.
Itarare bidai gori do, zene itara ãte hasor zaga edde fara okkolot zai hána kini loi hái fare."
Kintu hibaye zuwabe hitarare hodde,
Hitara hodde, "Ãra ki zai dui šot dinaror ruṭi kini aniyore hitarare háito ditam neki?"
Hibaye hitarare hodde,
Toi hitara zai sai aiyore hodde, "Fãssuwa ruṭi edde duwa mas."
Toi hibaye hitara beggunore gurup gurup gori hail keror uwore buwai dibolla hitarare hokum diye.
Manuš okkole laine laine ek šot ek šot, ar kiye fõnzašzon fõnzašzon gori boigiyegoi.

Toi hibaye fãswa ruṭi edde duwa mas loiyore asmanor mikka suk tui šukurana duwa zanaiye, ar ruṭigunore ṭura ṭura gori sahabi okkolor hãtot diye, zene hitara manuš okkolore hin baṛi di fare. Hendilla gori he mas duniware o hibaye bag gori diye, hitara beggunor maze baṛi dibolla.
Hitara beggune feṭbori háiye.
Tarfore sahabi okkole baro barang banga ruṭi edde mas feṛai loi dola goijje.
Háilde hitarar butore onumanik fãs hazar morodfuwain aššil.
Isaye fanir uwottu ãiṭṭe
Ar Isaye hehon hibar sahabi okkolore not uiṭṭo hoiye zene hitara hibar agottu zai dusora farot, Betsaidar mikka za, ar eṛe hiba nize manuš okkolore bidai goijje.
Toi manuš okkolottu bidai loi bade hiba munazat goribolla uwore faharot giye.
Toi zehon hazinna oiye, nogan doriyar maze aššil, hiba eṛe ekela zobinor kulot tai giyegoi.
Hibaye dekedde hitara beši hošṭo gori dar bar, kiyollahoile bataš hitarar uzan aššil. Dolfohor oibar age hiba doriyar uwottu ãṛiyore hitarar heṛe aišše. Hibaye hitarar ḍak bai zafan goijje.
Kintu hibaye fanir uwottu aṛedde dekiyore hitara but deker boli mone goijje edde kiskisai uiṭṭe,
Kiyollahoile hibare dekiyore beggune ḍoraiye. Isaye hehon hitara loi hota hoiye edde hodde,
Toi hiba hitarar not uiṭṭe edde bataš tamigiyegoi, edde hitara beši ammuwak oiye.
Kiyollahoile ruṭir goṭona ziyan goṭṭil hiyan hitara buzi no fare, kiyollahoile hitarar dil doro taki gilgoi.
Toi hitara okule zehon faraiyore Gennesaretot tiya goraiye edde nogan bainde.
Hitara nottu laimme mottor, manuš okkole hibare sini faijje.
Edde hitara he elehar butore hár mikka dũra dũri gora šuru goijje edde ošuikka manuš okkolore haiṭṭat gori hiba zeṛe ase boli fuinne heṛe ana šuru goijje.

Ar hiba šohorot, farat otóba geramot, hiba zeṛe giye heṛiyar manuš okkole biyaraimma okkolore aniyore bazaror butore dola goijje, ar hitara hibare foriyad goijje zene hitara šude hibar saddoror hãsagan oile sui fare. Ar zeduggune hiyan suiye, hitara beggune aram oiye.
